createworkers.hard_hat.hint: Right-click belts, depots, funnels and other Arm-compatible blocks to assign them
createworkers.hard_hat.assign_hint: Right-click a villager or enderman to put them to work
createworkers.message.hat_not_programmed: Assign some Arm-compatible blocks to the hard hat first
createworkers.message.already_employed: They are already on the clock
createworkers.message.too_young: Far too young for a job — come back when they have grown up
createworkers.message.too_many_targets: That is one inventory too many — a hard hat holds %1$s
createworkers.message.target_too_far: Too far from another assigned block (%1$s blocks apart, limit %2$s)
createworkers.message.too_far_from_job: Too far from the job site at %1$s, %2$s, %3$s — hire them nearer the work
createworkers.ponder.hard_hat.text_1: Workers carry items between inventories, much like a Mechanical Arm that can walk
createworkers.ponder.hard_hat.text_2: Right-Click Arm-compatible blocks while holding the Hard Hat to assign them
createworkers.ponder.hard_hat.text_3: The first Right-Click marks a block as an Input, a second turns it into an Output
createworkers.ponder.hard_hat.text_4: One worker walks between all of them, so every assigned block has to stay within reach of every other
createworkers.ponder.hard_hat.text_5: Right-Click a Villager or an Enderman with the programmed Hat to put them to work
createworkers.ponder.hard_hat.text_6: They will carry items from the assigned Inputs to the assigned Outputs, and keep at it
createworkers.ponder.hard_hat.text_7: Sneak and Right-Click them with an empty hand to clock them out — the Hat and anything they are carrying come back
